SYNTHETIC — fictional evaluation material.
JOB AD — Cambodia customer support, monthly wage Rs 38,000 equivalent. Employment visa arranged before departure. Recruitment charge ₹30,000 total, paid by bank transfer with receipt. Employer, agent and worker sign a tripartite contract before departure. Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance included. Apply in person at Desk 2, Training Row, Demo Nagar. Recruiting agent name and registration number are not displayed.
